worldcombat.skill.cottonspore.summary: Puff out a burst of cotton spores that cling to nearby enemies and harshly cut their Speed, a loss that does not recover on its own. It only reaches foes up close, so you must step into the crowd.
worldcombat.skill.cottonspore.use.0: Slow a pack of melee attackers at once
worldcombat.skill.cottonspore.use.1: Open a way out while surrounded
worldcombat.skill.cottonspore.use.2: Break up an enemy's close pursuit
worldcombat.skill.cottonspore.descriptio: A cottoned target loses %1$s Speed stage(s), and those stages stay lost rather than returning when the cotton fades; the cotton clings for about %2$s.
Bursts from you with a radius of %1$s, clinging to up to %2$s bodies.
worldcombat.skill.cottonspore.timing: Centred on you: windup %1$s, recovery %2$s, costs %3$s PP, cooldown %4$s.
worldcombat.skill.cottonspore.preference: On: the spores spread wider (radius ×1.25) but cling shallower, for less time and with a slightly shorter cooldown. Off: tighter (radius ×0.8) in exchange for one deeper Slow stage and a longer cling.
The companion only considers gathering spores while a threat is within this many blocks; smaller bursts at point-blank, larger walks into the crowd.
Only bursts when at least this many non-friendly bodies stand inside the spore radius; 1 means burst whenever someone is near.
When on, the companion may leave its post to close in and burst under a Hold order.
